decisions.summary: Row pondstock.py::stage_pond_stock#privy over the sty HELD, re-tiered E2 -> E3 on measure (m:wave86-privy-over-the-sty-held), not marked FIXED; the row stays DRIFTED in ranking.md (row 81) and audit/overrides.json with its full fix text unchanged: the household's privy over its sty with that farmstead's own privy dropped, the pair's place weighed and recorded as a GUESS, the claim re-cited.
decisions.why: This is the second exit round 1 named. Re-tiering defers the row in the order the GM asked for (easiest to hardest); it narrows nothing, because the row is still owed in full and the fix recorded against it is the one the exception ruling required. The E3 grounds are structural, not a matter of taste: no sty-to-household mapping exists (a sty is seated from the house centroid), and moving a privy off its farmstead touches farm_fixtures, the homestead fixture seats and the finished-map gate undrawn_rolls. That is several modules and a new relation, which is FR-003's own E3 definition. Waves 83-85 set the precedent.
